text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout of release v2026-03-20-3.7.2 -> prod. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Stage=25% traffic. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.7.2 Please watch SLO dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/slo/embed-service @sara please take watch for first 30m.

sara (oncall): taking it. I have the SLO panel up, enabling 1m alerts and p95/p99 columns. Will notify if anything hits thresholds. :eyes:

infra-bot: Alert: embed-service 5xx_rate() > 0.6% (threshold=0.2%). Alert link: https://alerts.redwood/alert/ENC-4521 
Query: ```sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embed-service",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embed-service"}[5m]))```
Snapshot: p95 latency +180ms vs baseline, error 5xx spike localized to pod group embed-srv-quantize.

maya (sre): seeing retries and OOM-like logs in quantize worker: `runtime: out of memory` followed by `killed process`. The quantize change in this release ups memory per-shard. Possible regression in memory tuning or kernel selection.

dan (release-lead): hold ramp. Pausing rollout and pinning traffic back to v3.7.1 for embed-service. Command I'm running: `infractl traffic pin --service embed-service --version v3.7.1 --reason "5xx spike during 25% ramp"`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 25%. Traffic pinned to v3.7.1. Notifying other services and the UI. Canary notes: rollback path available via `infractl rollout abort --release 3.7.2`.

sara (oncall): after pin observed 5xx drop to 0.15% over the last 3m, p95 back to baseline. Will keep 15m watch and then relax 1m alert to 5m.

maya (sre): filing bug and attaching logs + heap snapshots. Bug: RED-2345. Root cause hypothesis: quantize memory knob not applied for multi-GPU path; kernel selector picked a high-memory kernel under 25% traffic distribution. Adding guard in runtime to cap kernel selection.

dan (release-lead): opening a short rollforward postmortem draft and updating release notes to mark v3.7.2 as paused. Also adding rollback rationale and commands to the release doc. Assigning RED-2345 -> @maya to own follow-up.

infra-bot: Action log: `traffic.pin` executed by dan at 2129987687. Rollout state: PAUSED. Previous stable version: v3.7.1.

sara (oncall): SLOs stable for 10m. Closing active watch but leaving ticket open until bug fix validated. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Noted. When fix is ready we can schedule a small staged canary with memory profiling enabled and a stricter mid-rollback gate.

maya (sre): will add a CI perf test that reproduces the kernel selection path and a smoke check for per-pod memory before future ramps.

dan (release-lead): thanks everyone — good catch and fast coordination. Posting summary in #release-updates.
